content:
I have successfully (I think) updated the code accompanying @Heather Macbeth 's book Mechanics of Proof to work with Lean v4.27.0. Those interested in getting a copy for their teaching could DM me as I have not put it up as a public repository. An updated version of the book corresponding to the code updates is unfortunately not available.

The two most significant changes are removing the dependency on the custom definitions Int.Odd, Int.Even, Nat.Odd, and Nat.Even to avoid naming conflicts that broke certain imports (e.g. Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt) and completely removing the dependency on Duper since it is too much work to water it down so that the custom exhaust tactic would not be too powerful. Not too much was lost removing the exhaust tactic as all the proofs that used it in the book turned out to have simple proofs using other tactics covered in the book without adding too many lines.

The reason for not updating the code to v4.28.0 was mostly because of the deprecation of things related to Reflexive in favour of Std.Refl. Changing to Std.Refl would require much more than cosmetic changes to the proofs in the book. But I think the updates I put in should serve as a good starting point for those who want to bring the code to the bleeding edge.
